```yaml
name: Merge Roadmap Update

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get 10 most recent merged PRs
        id: get_prs
        run: |
          # Fetch the 10 most recent merged PRs excluding the current one if it's in the list
          # We use gh cli to get the list
          PRS=$(gh pr list --state merged --limit 10 --json number --jq '.[].number' | head -n 10)
          echo "prs=$PRS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update Roadmap Issue
        run: |
          # Find the roadmap issue number (assuming it's pinned or has a specific label/title)
          # For this example, we assume the roadmap is in a specific issue. 
          # In a real scenario, you might search for an issue with title "Sourcebot Roadmap"
          ROADMAP_ISSUE_NUMBER=$(gh issue list --search "Sourcebot Roadmap" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          
          if [ -z "$ROADMAP_ISSUE_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "Roadmap issue not found. Skipping update."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Get the current body of the issue
          CURRENT_BODY=$(gh issue view $ROADMAP_ISSUE_NUMBER --json body --jq '.body')
          
          # Generate the new list of PRs
          NEW_PR_LIST=""
          for PR_NUM in ${{ steps.get_prs.outputs.prs }}; do
            NEW_PR_LIST="$NEW_PR_LIST\n- #$PR_NUM"
          done
          
          # Define the section to replace
          SECTION_START="10 most recent [merged PRs](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged):"
          SECTION_END="## 🔮 Planned"
          
          # Check if the section exists
          if echo "$CURRENT_BODY" | grep -q "$SECTION_START"; then
            # Use sed to replace the content between the markers
            # This is a simplified approach. For complex markdown, a script might be better.
            # We will replace the block starting from SECTION_START up to (but not including) SECTION_END
            
            # Extract the part before the section
            BEFORE=$(echo "$CURRENT_BODY" | sed -n "1,/$SECTION_START/p")
            # Extract the part after the section
            AFTER=$(echo "$CURRENT_BODY" | sed -n "/$SECTION_END/,\$p")
            
            # Construct the new body
            NEW_BODY="${BEFORE}${NEW_PR_LIST}\n\n${AFTER}"
            
            # Update the issue
            gh issue edit $ROADMAP_ISSUE_NUMBER --body "$NEW_BODY"
            echo "Roadmap updated successfully."
          else
            echo "Roadmap section not found. Skipping update."
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
